text:
[slide 1]
OLYCOM
Lingaraj Mishra

[slide 2]
OLYCOM-Buisness proposal(OTN, Ethernet and public)
INTRODUCTION
Name : Lingaraj Mishra
Qualification : B.E in EE from NIT,R and EE from Univ of Stanford
Experience:
20+ years in Optical, Ethernet and Wireless Networking
Companies:
1- Nortel Networks – Metro Ethernet BU
To carry Ethernet, FC, FICON in GFP-T/F in G.709 in DWDM network  Transformed into OTN with sub-lambda and higher bandwidth core network in C, L carrier domain. Built Optera-Metro OM/OME3000, 5000 and 6500 series

[slide 3]
2-Dasan Networks Inc(2010)
Built M-3000 and M8000 series to carry Ethernet traffic from Mobile-backhaul to Core network. Built Broadcom-BCM switch based multi-carrier transport network switch both access and aggregator to carry traffic into the core. Bandwidth from 1G, 4G and 10G ports on access to carry 40G and 100G per switch.
3-Radisys Inc(2015)
Built world’s 1st CU/DU/RU for 1st 5G-capable RAN network.
Recent:
VVDN Technologies – Built B040 RU to ship to Airtel-5G and Meta.
OLYCOM-Buisness proposal(OTN, Ethernet and public)

[slide 4]
OLYCOM-Buisness proposal(OTN, Ethernet and public)
OLYCOM:
It has diversified products from OTN, Ethernet to Off-The-Rack products like ATCA boards and hot-pluggable modules.
1- Ethernet SWITCH
10/100/1000 Mbps PoE-PSE Ethernet Switches
I have expertise on all high-variant Ethernet Switches to Intelligent-Ethernet Switches. We can design Carrier-Grade Multi-SLOT Chassis base  switches to support more traffic and high-bandwidth aggregation.
2-Industrial Fiber Switches
I have expertise on Fiber-Ethernet Switches with carrying features like LACP. Also, SFP L2 features support like STP/RSTP/MSTP, ERP. L3 features support from DHCP, ICMP, NTP and management with RMON.

[slide 5]
OLYCOM-Buisness proposal(OTN, Ethernet and public)
3-Optical DWDM Switches
I have expertise on multi-port DWDM based muxponder and transponder card with multi-carrier Ethernet traffic being transported in Optical Core. OLYCOM supports 1U-4SLOT based multi-service platform.

[slide 6]
OLYCOM-Buisness proposal(OTN, Ethernet and public)
India, APAC & US – Market
1-india
India market is open for low-cost Ethernet and Optical networking Switches. It has demand and needs supply of similar low-cost swtches for different ISPs. This includes JIO and Airtel-5G.
2-APAC
ST, KT, SKT, China-Telecom, China Railway Signal(Govt) and others will be interested in low-cost Ethernet and Optical Switches.
3- US
US market demand can be ventured by MWC and MEC sales-expo and booth-events

[slide 7]
OLYCOM-Buisness proposal(OTN, Ethernet and public)
OLYCOM R&D
1-India
Depending on market-sales and market-need of other continents can be handled by off-shore team. LAB support and others can be explored.
Customer-Handling:
Customers from International-CONTINENTAL with English-speaking continents can be handled here.
